result.reason: The operative language establishes a mutual aggregate cap equal to the greater of 12 months’ paid-or-payable fees and USD 1,000,000, includes all required uncapped carve-outs, preserves the mutual consequential-damages exclusion, and excludes properly due Company fees from damages. The changes are targeted and preserve the existing damages exclusion. However, the fee lookback runs from the event giving rise to the claim rather than from the claim itself, contrary to the preferred formulation and potentially creating ambiguity for continuing conduct or delayed claims. Also, clause (b) could more clearly state whether it applies to Excluded Claims.
